context.topic: Setting up project documentation and a GitHub Actions workflow for a software repository.

groups.text: So today I want to walk you through how we set up the project docs.
So if you look at the vision.md here. And if you're going to
build something with it, you need to keep this file short.
The second file is the roadmap, which lists the milestones for version 2.1,
and we keep it in the repo next to the README.
>> Quick question: does that work with GitHub Actions?

corrections.reason: product name; GitHub is mentioned later

groups.text: >> Yes, it does. You just add a workflow file under .github/workflows,
and it runs on every pull request.
You don't need to install anything else. It's not that hard.
The first step is to run npm install, then npm test, and if the tests pass
and pytest for the Python part, you can push.
No, no, no, don't push to main directly.
See you in the next video.
